EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR47.2 crores against INR5 crores in Q1 FY26 with EBITDA margins at 6.7% against 0.8% a year ago and 5.3% in the preceding quarter.
This brings us to profit before tax of INR4.2 crores against a loss of INR38.6 crores in Q1 FY26.

Margins & costs: Gross margin came at 46.8%, an expansion of approximately 370 basis points over the same last quarter last year.
